items.title: Game 1 · Sessions 2–3 · AI Level 1: Use · Maze Runner, Voice-Controlled
items.symptom: In Fix the bug, the runner walks straight through walls — but only when going right.
items.answer: The right-arrow block steps back with change x by 4 — further into the wall. It should be change x by -4, the opposite of the move.

items.title: Game 2 · Sessions 4–5 · AI Level 2: Customize (flagship) · Catch the Apple, Train Your Own Sorter
items.symptom: In Fix the bug, apples that fall to the ground just sit there, and you never lose a life.
items.answer: The ground check is if y position < -250, but the stage only goes down to y = −180, and Scratch keeps sprites on the stage, so it is never true. Change −250 to −150.

items.title: Game 3 · Sessions 6–7 · AI Level 1: Use · Balloon Pop, Smile to Pop
items.symptom: In Fix the bug, all the balloons suddenly speed up or slow down together whenever a new balloon appears.
items.answer: speed was made for all sprites, so there is only one speed shared by every balloon; each new clone overwrites it. Delete it and make a new variable speed for this sprite only — then every clone keeps its own.

items.title: Game 4 · Sessions 8–9 · AI Level 1: Use · Dino Jump, Jump When You Jump
items.symptom: In Fix the bug, holding space makes the dino fly up and away.
items.answer: The jump check is only if key space pressed, so the dino can jump again in mid-air every frame. It needs and <y position = -95>: jump only when standing on the ground.

items.title: Game 5 · Sessions 10–11 · AI Level 2: Customize (flagship #2) · Space Shooter, Friend or Foe
items.symptom: In Fix the bug, when lives reach 0 the game never ends: no “Game over” sign and no high score, the ship stops moving, and new ships keep coming.
items.answer: The Ship broadcasts game over but the Sign waits for gameover (no space) — a different message, so the Sign never hears it. Pick game over in the Sign's when I receive block.

items.title: Game 6 · Sessions 12–13 · AI Level 1: Use (reused, continuous) · Car Racing, Lean to Steer
items.symptom: In Fix the bug, the lane lines slowly bunch together and gaps appear in the road.
items.answer: Five lines 72 apart make a pattern 360 long, and the stage is 360 tall, so the line position must use mod 360. The bug uses mod 300, so lines come back too early, bunch together and leave gaps. Change 300 to 360.

items.title: Game 7 · Sessions 14–15 · AI Level 1: Use + reliability lesson · Platform Adventure, Ask the Guide
items.symptom: In Fix the bug, when you reach the star, level 2 flashes and you win at once.
items.answer: After switching to level 2, the hero is still at the star's old place, and the star moves to its level-2 place right next to it, so the hero touches it and wins. start level must be called after next backdrop to send the hero back to the start.

items.title: Game 8 · Sessions 16–17 · AI Level 1: Use + reflect · Kindness Checker
items.symptom: In Fix the bug, “you are a loser” is not caught, but “you are an idiot” is.
items.answer: The counter starts at set i to 0. There is no item 0, and the loop runs as many times as there are words, so it checks items 0 to 7 — and never item 8, “loser”. Start at 1.
